review_evidence: README identifies the repository as an OpenAI MiniF2F fork with additional data and formal-statement fixes, intended as a cross-system automated-theorem-proving benchmark.
MiniF2F/Test.lean contains hundreds of named theorem statements, including IMO, AIME, AMC, algebra, induction, and number-theory problems; the unit-wide declaration scan found 489 declarations.
Benchmark/test naming does not make the mathematical statements disposable: the formal statements themselves are reusable prior-art search targets under the corpus inclusion invariant.
summary: Retain lean-dojo-mew: it is a MiniF2F formal-mathematics benchmark with hundreds of Lean theorem statements spanning olympiad and undergraduate mathematics.
